mapper.sql: select p.id, p.user_id, p.pet_id, p.content, p.images, p.video_url, p.video_cover, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.del_flag, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, pi.name as pet_name, false as is_like, false as is_followed from pet_post p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id left join pet_info pi on p.pet_id = pi.id

select p.id, p.user_id, p.pet_id, p.content, p.images, p.video_url, p.video_cover, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.del_flag, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, pi.name as pet_name, case when pl.id is not null then true else false end as is_like, case when uf.id is not null then true else false end as is_followed from pet_post p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id left join pet_info pi on p.pet_id = pi.id left join post_like pl on pl.post_id = p.id and pl.user_id = #{currentUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} left join user_follow uf on uf.follower_id = #{currentUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and uf.followee_id = p.user_id and uf.del_flag = '0'

select.where:
p.del_flag = '0'
and p.status = '1'
and (p.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and p.user_id = #{userId}
and p.user_id in
#{id}
and 1 = 0

choose.when: order by (p.like_count * 3 + p.comment_count * 5 + p.view_count * 0.1) desc, p.create_time desc

mapper.select:
select p.id, p.user_id, p.pet_id, p.content, p.images, p.video_url, p.video_cover, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.del_flag, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.nick_name as user_name, u.avatar as user_avatar, pi.name as pet_name, true as is_like, case when uf.id is not null then true else false end as is_followed from post_like pl inner join pet_post p on pl.post_id = p.id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id left join pet_info pi on p.pet_id = pi.id left join user_follow uf on uf.follower_id = pl.user_id and uf.followee_id = p.user_id and uf.del_flag = '0'
p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '1' and pl.user_id = #{userId}
and (p.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by pl.create_time desc
